follow-up time: Variable, up to 77 days for blood pressure normalization and 60 days for proteinuria resolution
exposure: Gestational age at initial examination and delivery
Onset of pre-eclampsia (early <32 weeks vs. late ≥32 weeks)
outcome: Time for normalization of blood pressure
cohort: 145 patients with gestational hypertension or pre-eclampsia who gave birth between January 2008 and October 2011
finding: The postpartum observation period of 12 weeks appears sufficient to differentiate pre-eclampsia and gestational hypertension from chronic hypertension or renal disease, and while gestational hypertension severity did not affect the recovery period, proteinuria severity and onset time of pre-eclampsia did.
gest_age: Variable, specified as early (<32 weeks) or late (≥32 weeks) for pre-eclampsia
